blocks.description: Each week has its own argument: what moved, why it mattered, and where to read the complete edition.

refs.description: Release failures became easier to see and understand, so a troubled rollout no longer looks healthy or mysteriously unfinished.
refs.title: Barkpark Cloud makes releases easier to trust

refs.description: Terminal commands became clearer about what happened, what is still running, and what needs attention next.
refs.title: The terminal explains everyday work more clearly

refs.description: Large pieces of work became easier to begin, follow, and hand over without losing the thread that explains why they exist.
refs.title: Long-running work becomes easier to start and follow

refs.description: Missing or failed results now say what happened instead of dressing an error up as an empty or successful page.
refs.title: Failures now explain what happened

refs.description: Release checks became harder to fool, including empty runs that once looked reassuring without proving anything.
refs.title: Quality checks now refuse empty test runs

refs.description: Work focused on returning the full picture instead of something partial or misleading. People can trust that what they see is the whole story.
refs.title: A bare-string was spread character by character, so the page never revalidated

blocks.title: August, week by week
